% cg-layout: pipeline
% figure check fixture (#1064): two labels turned a quarter, set on ticks
% 1mm apart so they run over each other, and a card whose top lies above
% their feet. Before #1064 the probe logged each turned label as a point
% and the overlap test set them aside, so this reported nothing.
\usetikzlibrary{positioning}%
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    tick/.style={fill, inner sep=0pt, outer sep=0pt, minimum width=0.9mm,
      minimum height=3mm},
    lab/.style={rotate=90, anchor=east, inner sep=1pt}]
  \node[tick] (e1) {};
  \node[tick, right=1mm of e1] (e2) {};
  \node[lab] (e1-n) at ([yshift=-1mm]e1.south) {departure};
  \node[lab] (e2-n) at ([yshift=-1mm]e2.south) {arrival};
  \draw (e1) -- (e2);
  \node[draw, minimum width=30mm, minimum height=8mm, anchor=north,
    below=8mm of e1] (band-card) {};
\end{tikzpicture}%
